rationale: Sierra Reads EP. 2 — 'Hinge Anaphora' (writer-agent Draft 8). Triple-denial-then-confession-then-button. The triple denial of increasingly absurd Hinge stalking moves builds the absurdity, the confession admits it all, and the 'Today. Yet.' double-button is the dryest possible landing. Universal premise — every woman has either done this or watched her best friend do it.
